How To Edit Videos Using Claude Opus 5.5(Tutorial)

In this video, we break down how to use Claude Opus 5.5 to create complete videos with AI, from motion graphics and animations to fully edited videos. Learn our 6-step workflow for training Claude on your visual style, testing animations, building storyboards, and generating production-ready videos. We’ll also explore how to convert AI-generated videos into editable After Effects projects and connect Claude with Premiere Pro for further editing.
